name: Cloudflare Relay Setup
description: Generate a compatible Orca relay deployment configuration for Cloudflare Workers.

settings.title: Relay director hostname
settings.description: Your public HTTPS hostname, for example relay.example.com. It should point to the Cloudflare Worker.

settings.title: Relay edge hostname
settings.description: A second public HTTPS hostname for the Worker edge/cell, for example edge.relay.example.com.

settings.title: Postgres URL
settings.description: The managed Postgres connection URL used by Hyperdrive. Keep this private; the plugin stores it as an encrypted secret.

settings.title: Relay auth issuer
settings.description: The HTTPS issuer used by Orca Cloud relay JWTs. Usually https://login.onorca.dev for the hosted Orca authentication service.

settings.title: Relay JWKS URL
settings.description: Public JWKS URL of the relay auth issuer. Usually https://login.onorca.dev/.well-known/jwks.json.
